## Change and ownership

Assigned model/folder and purpose:

## Validation

Exact commands and observed outcomes; identify anything not run.

## Experiment provenance

View, protocol, held-out folds, seeds, final configuration, source commit, metrics and artifact paths. Show that test identities were excluded from training.

## Review

- Shared API/data/config changes coordinated with other owners
- No dataset images, archives, checkpoints, secrets, or large/unreviewed outputs
- Real measured results distinguished from planned experiments
- Citations, AI disclosure and contributions updated as required
